markers.name: flavouring
markers.why: added flavour, to make it taste of something it has little of

markers.name: sweetener
markers.why: sweet taste without sugar (artificial or sugar alcohols)

markers.name: emulsifier
markers.why: keeps oil and water mixed: a texture additive home cooking never uses

markers.name: modified starch
markers.why: chemically altered starch for texture and shelf life

markers.name: maltodextrin
markers.why: refined starch filler, absorbed like sugar

markers.name: milk proteins
markers.why: separated milk proteins added for texture or protein claims

markers.name: protein isolate
markers.re: protein isolate|hydrolysed|soya protein|soy protein|pea protein|wheat gluten
markers.why: extracted, refined protein added to bump protein or texture

markers.name: anti-caking / glazing / humectant
markers.why: processing aids that keep things flowing, shiny or moist

watch.name: nitrites/nitrates
watch.why: curing salts in processed meat, linked to bowel cancer risk

watch.name: carrageenan
watch.why: seaweed thickener, contested for gut effects

watch.name: phosphates
watch.why: texture and water-retaining additives; high intake is a concern

watch.name: titanium dioxide
watch.why: whitening colour, banned as a food additive in the EU

watch.name: palm oil
watch.why: high in saturated fat; you avoid it
